meta.environment: Claude Browser pane (Chromium), served from file:// snapshot
meta.method: For each of 55 screens: jump(screen), enumerate DOM elements with a React onClick prop, click each, record navigations and window errors. State snapshot taken before crawl and restored after.

errorAnalysis.crawlerArtifacts: 20 of 22 errors are 'el.click is not a function' on SVG child elements (tags, publicProfile screens) — SVGElement lacks HTMLElement.click(); dispatching MouseEvent instead succeeds. Not app defects.
errorAnalysis.realErrors: 2 × "Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'on')" raised while bulk-clicking with stale element references (medicalProfile/publicProfile sequence). A per-control replay of all three suspect screens with fresh state between clicks produced ZERO errors, so this is only reachable by clicking a detached/stale row (fast double-tap race). Logged as DEF-002, P3.
